candidates.change_summary: Change call to call{value: 0} to pass zero value explicitly (semantic no-op removed) — replaced with call{value: msg.value} to forward ether, altering observable state if callee transfers or uses msg.value.
Drop the require so failures of the external call are ignored; this changes observable behavior because forward may revert originally but now will not, changing post-call state visibility.
Invert the require condition to require failure, causing forward to revert on success and proceed on failure — observable behavioral change.

Remove the parentheses scoping around the call and require (move statement) — replace with storing the success in a state-affecting local variable and then require; keeps semantics but different statement order and introduces a new local assignment line (semantic change kept minimal).
